## Preserve Markdown code and verify hook behavior

- Unbold preserves fenced, indented, and inline code, plus escaped punctuation, while removing bold markers from prose.
- The gopls hook now fails when diagnostics are emitted; the underlying `gopls check` command returns success even for errors.
- End-to-end checks exercise installed hooks in a temporary consuming repository, covering lint failures, formatter rewrites, ignored files, and clean second runs.
- Oxlint reads ignore patterns from the bundled configuration so the wrapper and policy share one list.
- `make release VERSION=<version>` prepares release metadata. CI publishes the release after validation and tests pass.
